Class PythonAsyncioStreams.GeneratorSubscription

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.PythonAsyncioStreams.GeneratorSubscription
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subscription
Enclosing class:
PythonAsyncioStreams
@Internal public static final class PythonAsyncioStreams.GeneratorSubscription extends Object implements Subscription
The subscription handed to a Java subscriber of a Python async iterator, and the facade the Python driver signals through.

Demand and cancellation travel to the driver on the loop; the driver advances the iterator only with positive demand and reports elements, the error or the completion back through next(Value), error(Value) and complete(). A terminal signal is emitted at most once, and no element after it. The stream counts as an active execution of its context from the subscription until the driver has released the iterator, so a graceful shutdown waits for the generator's cleanup.

Since:
5.2.3
